result.topic_en: Euler explains that determining the vibratory motion of an elastic lamina requires the integral calculus of functions of two variables, and that the elementary accelerating forces implied by the analytic formulas must be equivalent to the real forces acting on the lamina, which is held only by being fixed in a wall.

452 DE MOTV VIBRATORIO
directione X V, vbi folum tempus $t$ variari affumitur, ita exhiberi debet, vt fit $\frac{1}{2b}\left(\frac{ddy}{dt^2}\right)$, ex quo manifeftum eft, hanc inueftigationem ad illam partem calculi integralis pertinere, quae circa functiones duarum variabilium verfatur, atque hoc ipfo ifta quaeftio ab aliis, vbi vnius tantum variabilis functiones quaeruntur, maxime difcrepat ac prorfus fingularem foluendi methodum poftulat, fiquidem folutionem perfectam et latiffime patentem defideremus, quemadmodum occafione Problematis de chordis vibrantibus faepius iam eft inculcatum.

V. Vt ergo talis motus, qualem laminae noftrae illis formulis Analyticis tribuimus, reuera producatur, fingulis elementis $Xy = dx$, quorum maffula feu pondufculum eft $\frac{K\,dx}{k}$, vis acceleratrix fecundum directionem $YV = \frac{1}{2b}\left(\frac{ddy}{dt^2}\right)$, hincque vis motrix $= \frac{K\,dx}{2kb}\left(\frac{ddy}{dt^2}\right)$ applicata eft intelligenda, fcilicet fi fingulis laminae elementis huiusmodi vires $YV = \frac{K\,dx}{2bk}\left(\frac{ddy}{dt^2}\right)$ effent applicatae, illae praecife illum ipfum motum laminae effent inducturae, quem formulae noftrae Analyticae inuoluunt, quare vt hic motus cum veritate conueniat, neceffe eft, vt omnes iftae vires elementares aequiualeant illis viribus, quibus lamina reuera follicitatur, laminae autem nullae aliae vires funt applicatae, nifi quibus muro infixa retinetur.

VI. In hoc ipfo autem cardo quaeftionis praecipue verfatur, quales vires intra murum exferi debe-
